CLINICAL DOCUMENTATION — NARRATIVE SPECIALTY CONSULT NOTE V1
Patient: Jessica White | MRN: PAT-60017 | DOB: 1986-08-15 | Gender: Female | Doc ID: NARRATIVE_0017
Encounter Date: 2025-06-09 | Discharge/Note Date: 2025-06-12 | Provider: Dr. Sarah Jenkins, MD
REASON FOR CONSULTATION
Consult requested by primary medical team regarding refractory clinical optimization and therapeutic titration. Consultant
team: Cardiovascular Medicine Consult Service.
CHRONOLOGICAL CLINICAL NARRATIVE
CHRONOLOGICAL CLINICAL NARRATIVE: We were asked to evaluate patient Jessica White, who was admitted three
days ago with complex multisystem decompensation. On initial presentation, initial biomarker profiling revealed white blood
cell count of 14.9 10*3/uL (HIGH). Subsequent evaluation demonstrated that serum platelet count was 244.9 10*3/uL. Prior
outpatient regimens had proven insufficient to achieve therapeutic stability.
HOSPITAL COURSE & TRAJECTORY
HOSPITAL COURSE & TRAJECTORY: During inpatient specialty evaluation, the consultant team adjusted pharmacological
therapy. The patient was initiated on Cephalexin 250 mg by mouth QID for 10 days. Following this intervention, trajectory
assessment showed calcium of 7.1 mg/dL (LOW). Clinical response has been favorable with marked improvement in
objective metabolic parameters.
FOCUSED PHARMACOTHERAPY RECOMMENDATIONS
FOCUSED PHARMACOTHERAPY RECOMMENDATIONS: The specialty team recommends the following maintenance
regimen: continue Metoprolol 25 mg oral BID; and titrate Lisinopril 5 mg oral every morning. Avoid NSAIDs and nephrotoxic
exposures.
CONSULTANT ASSESSMENT & SPECIALTY PLAN
The patient is stabilized and appropriate for transfer to the regular step-down floor. Re-evaluate laboratory markers in 48
hours. Thank you for this interesting consultation.
